title: 再好的朋友也有分別時
titleEn: The Best of Friends Must Part
titleZh: 再好的朋友也有分別時
imageAlt: Illustrated learning card for The Best of Friends Must Part.
imageAltZh: 「再好的朋友也有分別時」學習插圖。

source.reference: Oxford proverb index; original teaching scenes and questions

meaning.en: Even very close friends sometimes have to say goodbye or live apart.
meaning.zh: 再親近的朋友，也會有暫時或長久分別的時候。

formulas.formula: the best of friends must part
formulas.highlight: the best of friends must part

examples.en: After graduation, the two old friends were heading to different cities—the best of friends must part.
examples.zh: 畢業禮後，兩位多年的好友要到不同城市升學。
examples.highlight: the best of friends must part

instructions.en: Choose the one sentence that keeps the situation’s facts and uses “the best of friends must part” accurately.
instructions.zh: 選出唯一保留情境事實、又正確使用「the best of friends must part」的英文句子。

questions.prompt: Two close friends will study in different cities after graduation and plan to meet during holidays.
questions.promptZh: 兩位好友畢業後要到不同城市讀書，約好假期再見。
questions.answer: The friends will say goodbye without ending their friendship—the best of friends must part.
questions.answerZh: 兩位好友畢業後要到不同城市讀書，約好假期再見。

questions.prompt: A childhood friend sees Ching off at the train and they promise to keep calling.
questions.promptZh: 童年朋友送阿晴上火車，兩人答應繼續通話。
questions.answer: They must part at the station although they intend to stay close—the best of friends must part.
questions.answerZh: 童年朋友送阿晴上火車，兩人答應繼續通話。

questions.prompt: Camp ends and two new friends return to their own schools.
questions.promptZh: 露營結束，兩名新好友返回各自的學校。
questions.answer: The friends must say goodbye as camp ends—the best of friends must part.
questions.answerZh: 露營結束，兩名新好友返回各自的學校。

questions.promptZh: 阿正的好友要移民，他們在機場擁抱，約定每月視像通話。
questions.answer: They part at the airport while planning to keep in touch—the best of friends must part.
questions.answerZh: 阿正的好友要移民，他們在機場擁抱，約定每月視像通話。

questions.prompt: Two longtime colleagues retire and move to separate places; they leave the office together one last time.
questions.promptZh: 兩位老同事退休後各自搬家，最後一次一起走出辦公室。
questions.answer: Their shared work chapter ends as they part—the best of friends must part.
questions.answerZh: 兩位老同事退休後各自搬家，最後一次一起走出辦公室。

questions.prompt: On the last night of holiday, two friends exchange addresses before returning to their countries.
questions.promptZh: 假期最後一晚，兩個好友交換地址，第二天各自回國。
questions.answer: They part tomorrow while leaving a way to stay connected—the best of friends must part.

questions.prompt: Two friends who learned piano together since childhood will join different orchestras next year.
questions.promptZh: 兩個從小一起學琴的朋友，明年會進入不同的樂團。
questions.answer: Their paths separate although their friendship may continue—the best of friends must part.

questions.promptZh: 阿珊最後一次為搬走的好友送午餐，兩人說會保持聯絡。
questions.answer: Their farewell marks a parting, not necessarily a broken friendship—the best of friends must part.
questions.answerZh: 阿珊最後一次為搬走的好友送午餐，兩人說會保持聯絡。

questions.promptZh: 營地義工一起工作了整個暑假，活動結束時互相擁抱道別。
questions.answer: The volunteers part after a close summer together—the best of friends must part.

questions.answerZh: 姊妹般親近的兩位朋友，一人結婚後搬到外地，兩人仍定期寫信。

questions.promptZh: 球隊最後一場比賽後，兩位好友將加入不同球會。
questions.answer: Their time as teammates ends even if their friendship does not—the best of friends must part.

questions.promptZh: 探訪一週後，兩位好朋友在碼頭揮手告別，約定冬天再見。
questions.answer: They part now despite hoping to meet again in winter—the best of friends must part.
